summary:
Build passes.

**What I changed** (item 4 only): linked the Inter Google font in `index.html` and made it the base font in `src/style.css`; the light-grey page background and single accent colour scheme were already in place, so I left them. Added soft card shadow, rounded inputs with a focus glow (ring instead of the hard outline), and smooth hover transitions on buttons and links.

**What I did not do, and why**: items 1–3 and the Angular-specific parts of item 4 describe a different application — an Angular `AppModule` Tutorial Manager with Bootstrap 4, a tutorials service, and `src/app/components/`, `src/index.html`, `src/styles.css`. This repository is a React + Vite account-signup demo with three pages (sign up, log in, welcome) and no tutorials entity, navbar, or Bootstrap. Building a HeaderComponent, a tutorials card grid and Add/Edit tutorial pages here would mean inventing a feature that does not exist rather than restyling one, so I left them alone. There are also no component tests in this repo to update. Reading taken: apply only the parts of the request that have a subject in this codebase.

No password-related field or form was touched, so the recorded password rules did not come into play.
blockers: Not applied -- 1. HeaderComponent in src/app/components/header/ declared in AppModule, gradient navbar with Tutorial Manager logo / Tutorials / Add Tutorial links, plus a footer: This repo is React + Vite with no Angular, no AppModule and no such navigation; the described component has no subject here

Not applied -- 2. Tutorials list card grid, search bar, Published/Pending pill badges, empty state, red Remove All button: No tutorials feature, list page, or tutorial entity exists in this repository
Not applied -- 3. Add/Edit tutorial pages restyled as centered cards with Bootstrap alerts: No Add/Edit tutorial pages exist here, and Bootstrap is not a dependency of this project
Not applied -- Light grey page background and one consistent colour scheme: Already true — src/style.css already uses a light grey --bg and a single accent colour
Not applied -- Shared styles in src/styles.css: This project's shared stylesheet is src/style.css; I extended it rather than creating a second near-identical file
Not applied -- Update the existing component tests to match: This repository contains no component tests

Visual verification failed: The app is a React login/signup demo with no Tutorial Manager UI at all — the rendered page shows only a plain login card on a light grey background, with no gradient indigo-to-purple navbar/HeaderComponent, no footer, no tutorials card grid, search bar, status pills or Remove All button. The applied diff touched only index.html (Inter font link) and src/style.css (26 lines), so items 1-3 of the instruction are not visibly satisfied.

context_sharing.notes: The changed files (index.html, src/style.css) contain no API calls, routes, or type definitions — index.html only mounts /src/main.jsx into #root and loads an Inter webfont from fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com; style.css is purely presentational. src/router.jsx is a client-side path router only (no HTTP). No backend contract is implemented or consumed by this change.
